name: verify_disk_check_flag
description: Calls two routines and compares the value returned by one against a stored reference word. On a mismatch it writes an all-ones flag into the state block, otherwise it writes zero. The referenced text is a prompt asking for the original disk in drive A.

name: dispatch_two_subcalls
description: Does nothing except call two other routines in sequence and return. It touches no registers, memory or hardware itself.

name: advance_timed_state_when_due
description: Checks that a counter is positive, an enable word is set and a busy flag is clear. When a position value plus 40 has not passed the reference value in the data register, or a force flag is set, it stores the new position, sets the busy flag, calls a routine with the advanced value and then clears the flag.

name: forward_to_one_subroutine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, passing nothing and changing no state.

name: copy_table_entry_to_state
description: Reads a 16-bit word from a lookup table, indexed by a state word doubled, and stores it into a state field.

name: forward_to_one_subroutine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, passing nothing and changing no state.

name: copy_table_entry_to_state
description: Reads a 16-bit word from a lookup table, indexed by a state word doubled, and stores it into a state field. The code is identical to its neighbour, so it is probably a second caller path for the same table lookup.

name: store_three_biased_values
description: Calls a routine three times and stores each returned word into three consecutive state words, each reduced by 256.

name: next_random_scaled_value
description: Advances a 16-bit linear congruential generator held in the state block, using multiplier 31415 and increment 1. It returns the new masked state multiplied by the input value in the data register and shifted down to a scaled result.

name: submit_clamped_library_call
description: When a state word is zero, it clamps a stored value to the range minus 5 to plus 5, calls one routine, then calls a library entry point through a jump-table pointer with fixed constants and the clamped value, and calls that entry point again.

name: call_with_swapped_state_pair
description: Saves two long words from the state block, overwrites them with another pair from the same block, calls one routine, then restores the saved words.

name: blit_fixed_rectangle
description: Calls one routine for setup, then passes a fixed rectangle and bitplane arguments to the BltBitMap stub through the graphics library base, and calls that stub again without arguments.

name: walk_object_list_entries
description: Sets a state word to 200 and, when a status bit is clear and a mode word is zero, follows a linked list of records, calling a routine with fixed arguments for each one. It then resets the state word to 150.

name: run_countdown_entry_loop
description: Saves a pointer field, then calls a routine once for each count from a state value down to zero, passing the same fixed constants each time. It restores the pointer and sets a state word to 19.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: stub_gap_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an unreached filler between routines.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes the integer square root of the value in the data register by a bit-by-bit search that squares candidate values and compares them with the input. Negative inputs leave the result at zero.

name: stub_gap_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an unreached filler between routines.

name: send_serial_byte_when_idle
description: Busy-waits until a shared flag word is zero, sets that flag to all ones, then writes the low byte of its argument with an extra marker bit into the serial data register.

name: enable_transmit_buffer_interrupt
description: Writes a 1 to one hardware register, clears the shared flag word, then writes a set-bit mask with the top bit set to the interrupt enable register. The top bit set means the bit is enabled.

name: init_serial_receive_state
description: Clears the serial receive and transmit counters and several state fields, sets the serial period register to a fixed divider value, and enables the receive-buffer interrupt through the interrupt enable register.

name: handle_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Runs on each serial receive interrupt. It reads the received byte, then either appends it to an 80-entry ring buffer or, while a decode mode is active, looks it up in a 32-entry table to drive a small state machine, and finally writes the interrupt acknowledge value.

name: store_word_and_ack_interrupt
description: Stores the low word of the second data argument in a state field, then writes a fixed acknowledge value to a hardware register.

name: decode_serial_character_mode
description: Turns the received byte into a table index by subtracting 42, reads the code stored at that index, and sets one of several mode flags depending on whether the code is empty, valid or out of range. It then writes the interrupt acknowledge value.

name: reset_serial_decode_flags
description: Clears three decode state words, sets a fourth to all ones, and acknowledges the serial interrupt.

name: append_byte_to_serial_ring
description: Stores the received byte at the write index of the 80-entry serial ring buffer, advances the index and wraps it to zero after the last entry, then acknowledges the interrupt.

name: test_serial_buffer_has_data
description: Returns minus one when the read index of the serial ring buffer differs from its write index, meaning unread data is present, and zero otherwise.

name: read_serial_buffer_byte
description: Waits until the serial ring buffer holds unread data, returns the byte at the read index, and advances the read index with wraparound at 80 entries.

name: service_pending_serial_event
description: When a mode word is set, clears a pending flag and returns. If a second flag is set instead, it calls one or two routines, depending on another word, and clears that flag.

name: receive_packet_and_dispatch
description: Waits with bounded countdown loops for a first byte, then copies a counted run of bytes from the serial input into a buffer. It then dispatches on the decoded code to one of many handlers that change state and copy blocks. The decompiled body is truncated, so the full dispatch table is not visible.

name: poll_bounded_until_clear
description: Calls a poll routine up to 41 times and returns as soon as it reports zero. Each non-zero result triggers a second routine before the next poll.

name: send_byte_sequence_with_handshake
description: Saves the byte at a source pointer, offsets that byte by 42 in memory, then runs a count-controlled loop that waits on a shared flag and calls a routine for each step. It optionally calls two more routines afterwards.

name: write_byte_row_until_limit
description: Computes an end address from a base and an offset, then repeatedly stores a state byte at the current pointer and calls a routine. It returns once the position passes the end value or the mode byte equals 4.

name: set_mode_four_and_dispatch
description: Sets a global mode byte to 4 and calls one routine.

name: dispatch_state_code_handlers
description: Reads the current state code and runs one of several handler paths. Those paths copy a nine-byte block, set mode and buffer values, or forward status fields to a routine. Codes with no handler are returned unchanged. The decompiled body is truncated before the end of the dispatch.

name: publish_status_fields_to_buffer
description: Sets a mode byte to 1, or to 11 when either of two state words is set. It then copies several state fields into fixed global buffer addresses and calls one routine.

name: run_until_state_24
description: Saves a timeout word, clears it, sets a command code of 8 and a pointer, then calls a routine repeatedly until the state byte reaches 24 or the time window expires. It restores the timeout word afterwards.

name: start_mode_26_transfer
description: Saves a timeout word, clears it, and sets a command code of 26 with source pointers and a timeout value of 2400. It calls one routine and then sets a state word to all ones before restoring the timeout.

name: copy_nine_byte_name_block
description: When a state word is negative, copies nine bytes from a fixed source table into the global buffer. The referenced text is a list of credit names.

name: begin_or_end_transfer_session
description: When a state word is nonzero, resets the session state and calls several routines to end it. Otherwise it reads four status values and, if none is negative, starts a new session by setting its state words and calling a routine.

name: await_sync_then_receive_block
description: Waits with timeouts for a period character on the serial line, then reads decoded codes until code 16 arrives. It copies a nine-byte block into the global buffer and then sends follow-up codes and returns a failure value if the timeout expires.

name: wait_thirteen_display_frames
description: Calls the graphics library WaitTOF entry thirteen times in a row, which pauses for thirteen display frames.

name: stub_gap_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an unreached filler between routines.

name: compute_clamped_distance_falloff
description: Takes the high part of a state word after dividing by 256, drops its sign, and returns 60 minus that magnitude. It returns zero when the magnitude is above 60, and also calls one routine.

name: update_moving_object_positions
description: Advances an object's position by adding its velocity values, and while its step counter is positive it adjusts the velocities and steps the counter. When the counter reaches its limit, the active flag is cleared. The decompiled body is truncated before the end.

name: init_object_motion_from_random
description: When the record is inactive, marks it active, clears its motion fields, sets two fixed rate values, and seeds three position fields with successive routine results, each minus 64.

name: init_object_motion_fixed
description: When the record is inactive, marks it active, clears its motion fields, sets two fixed rate values, and sets the first position field to minus 80 with the others at zero.

name: set_directional_motion_rates
description: Sets two speed values and two step values, then flips the signs of the speed values and the step values according to the low two bits of a control word. It finally clears a fourth field.

name: init_position_from_routine_samples
description: When the record is inactive, marks it active, sets a fixed rate, and seeds three position fields from successive routine results minus 255. It then stores a sign-adjusted value derived from a fourth routine result.

name: update_timer_status_bits
description: Advances a counter by three and another by seven, sets status bits in a flags word when each counter reaches a threshold, and then calls two routines.

name: register_active_record
description: Sets two fields of a record to a sentinel and zero, calls one routine, marks the record active, stores its pointer in a global slot, and then calls another routine.

name: project_point_into_arrays
description: Looks up two values in tables, multiplies and scales them, divides by a divisor and stores the results as offset-adjusted values in two output arrays.

name: initialize_projection_tables
description: Runs once only. It sets a guard flag, fills three parallel tables with routine results offset by minus 63 and writes three constants per entry, then fills another table with routine results offset by 23.

name: update_projected_point_tables
description: Advances each entry of a set of point tables by its velocity values and counts live entries. While entries remain, it projects each live point through weighted sums and a division and stores the coordinates.

name: populate_scaled_column_tables
description: Loops over up to 800 entries and, for each entry marked active, stores a state byte into a buffer, calls routines, and fills three tables with values scaled by a right shift of 14. It records the number of entries processed.

name: select_and_store_source_byte
description: Calls two routines, then loads a byte from one of two sources chosen by a mode word and stores it in a state field.

name: step_parallel_arrays_per_frame
description: Runs a per-frame pass over counter arrays, calling a routine for each positive counter and updating two parallel arrays by fixed increments. It then decrements the active count for entries that run out.

name: reset_entry_table_with_sentinels
description: Clears a flag, fills a 500-entry table with all-ones sentinel values, zeroes two counters and sets a deadline 3000 units after the current timer value.

name: wait_four_display_frames
description: Calls the graphics library WaitTOF entry four times, pausing for four display frames.

name: run_setup_animation_loop
description: Sets a guard flag, optionally runs one setup call, clears a table of sentinels, and then runs a 70-iteration loop. Each pass clamps four state values, calls a routine, and waits for the blitter through the graphics library. Afterwards it scans for a nonzero entry, resets two counters and returns.

name: init_identity_rotation_matrix
description: Stores a 3-by-3 fixed-point rotation matrix in the state block with diagonal entries of 16384 (unit scale) and all other entries zero.

name: rotate_matrix_about_first_axis
description: Stores two input values, saves the current matrix row values, and then writes new matrix entries as sums and differences of products of the inputs with the existing entries, scaled by four and truncated to 16 bits.

name: rotate_matrix_about_second_axis
description: Stores two input values, saves the current matrix row values, and then writes new matrix entries as sums and differences of products of the inputs with the existing entries, scaled by four and truncated to 16 bits. The sign of one input is reversed for some entries.

name: rotate_matrix_about_third_axis
description: Stores two input values, saves the current matrix row values, and then writes new matrix entries as sums and differences of products of the inputs with the existing entries, scaled by four and truncated to 16 bits.

name: test_position_against_planes
description: Tests a position against up to four plane records stored at 40-byte stride, each as a sum of three products minus an offset. It returns the index of the first record whose result is 99 or less, along with the minimum test value.

name: resolve_pairwise_contact_response
description: Computes the offsets between two objects and a distance from the squared components. When that distance is nonzero, it scales a dot-product response and applies it to the three velocity components before storing them.

name: test_object_against_planes
description: Tests an object's position against up to four plane records, each as a sum of three products minus an offset. It returns the index of the first record whose result is 99 or less, or minus one if none qualifies, and reports the minimum test value.

name: run_timed_playback_loop
description: When two state words are zero and a third is set, it sets a deadline 2600 units after the current timer value. It then calls a routine repeatedly until the deadline passes or a status byte equals 4, and clears a state word afterwards.

name: reset_simulation_state_fields
description: Calls one routine, then resets a large set of state fields to initial values. These include sentinel values of all ones, fixed start positions and table pointers, and a far-future deadline.

name: initialize_world_state_tables
description: Clears a 175-entry buffer and a set of state fields, derives a scale value from a level table lookup, and fills a 40-entry record table with routine-sampled values. It then resets flag arrays and sets several start values. The decompiled body is truncated before the end.

name: run_seven_update_steps
description: Copies a state long into a global, stores a constant as another global, and then calls seven routines in sequence.

name: run_frame_update_sequence
description: Calls nine routines in sequence, stores a timer value, and then calls two more routines.

name: derive_lookup_position_fields
description: Reads an entry from a table for the current index, adds a base value and wraps the sum into range by subtracting a limit. It then stores the result along with derived fields scaled by eight and halved.

name: set_palette_entries_for_state
description: Writes four color words into a palette table, choosing one of two palette sets from the sign of a state word. It also sets three counter fields to fixed values.

name: render_two_region_passes
description: When a state word is negative, it saves two pointers, runs one routine for a 150-row region, redirects the pointer to a buffer, runs the routine again for a 319-wide, 150-row region, then restores the pointers and calls one more routine.

name: reset_text_field_and_timer
description: Fills six text cells with space characters, increments a counter, resets several flag and state fields, and sets a deadline 180000 units after the current timer value.

name: build_record_chain_from_table
description: Resets counters and builds a linked chain of four records. Each record links to the next and stores a lookup-table value for its index, and the starting record depends on a state flag.

name: update_record_chain_fields
description: Resets several state fields, then walks a linked chain of records, storing each record's index and table-derived values. It finishes by setting the timer deadline.

name: run_main_update_loop
description: Runs a loop that services pending operations, updates state flags, calls several update sub-routines and repeats. The decompiled body is truncated, so only the visible control flow is described.

name: run_results_screen_loop
description: Runs a state loop that resets per-step fields, calls update routines and repeats until a stop condition. Its referenced text includes race results headings, so it likely drives the results display. The body is truncated.

name: record_best_time_entry
description: Walks a linked list of records to find the one with the smallest timing field. If that time beats the stored best for the current slot, it stores the time and copies a ten-byte label from a table into the slot.

name: store_best_time_label
description: When the current time is lower than the stored best for the slot, stores the new time and copies a nine-byte label into the slot's storage. It then sets a marker word to minus one. The referenced text is a list of credit names.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is empty, so this routine does nothing beyond returning. The listing is probably a stub or unresolved code.

name: draw_status_lines_when_idle
description: When two state words are zero, it calls three routines to draw status lines. It follows one of two paths depending on whether a further state word is set. The referenced text includes qualifying and position headings.

name: show_lead_timer_when_idle
description: When four state words are zero, it calls two routines. The referenced text is a timer caption, so these calls probably display a lead timer.

name: add_fifteen_to_timer_field
description: Calls two routines and then adds 15 to a 32-bit field in the state block. The referenced text includes lap and breakdown headings.

name: toggle_flag_and_update_loop
description: Toggles a flag word, then runs a loop that calls update routines and checks several state words to decide when to continue or stop. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: copy_record_fields_to_row
description: Advances a row counter, then walks up to six records, copying each record's leading word into the current table row and adding a small per-slot offset to a field of the record.

name: update_motion_step_state
description: Calls several routines and then updates motion and timing values from flag bits and per-step counters. It also updates a set of state words that are used by later steps. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: wrap_heading_angles
description: When a state flag is nonzero, it adds per-mode deltas to angle values and wraps them into a 360-degree range by adding or subtracting 360 as needed. The listing is unreached in the static flow.

name: store_wrapped_heading_pair
description: Wraps one angle value into a 360-degree range, stores it with a second value in state fields, and copies the results to paired fields. The decompiled body is truncated. It is unreached in the static flow.

name: store_wrapped_heading_and_update
description: Wraps an angle value into a 360-degree range and stores it along with a second value and a derived value. It clears a related field when a flag is set and then calls several routines. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: update_audio_channel_volumes
description: Writes one of two volume levels, 40 or 60, to the audio channel volume registers, chosen from a state word. It then updates speed-like state values from the input and flags and calls several routines.

name: set_audio_period_from_state
description: Derives a period value from a table entry and state fields, scales it, and clamps it between 299 and 810. It then writes the clamped period to the audio period registers for the first two channels.

name: update_angular_velocity_damping
description: Clears two state words, then adjusts an angular velocity by a damping term derived from its magnitude. The adjustment depends on bits of a control byte, and a flag is set when the value changes. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: decode_joystick_input_bits
description: Reads joystick movement and button register values and builds a four-bit direction code from the port bits. It sets the top bit when the fire button line reads low, meaning pressed, then stores the result in a state byte.

name: update_scaled_position_state
description: Multiplies and shifts state fields using values from a table, then updates the state block and calls several routines. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: update_audio_channel_two
description: Loops over state entries and updates the period and volume registers of the third audio channel from computed values. The listing is unreached in the static flow and truncated.

name: check_elapsed_interval_and_count
description: Returns zero if less than 400 timer units have passed since the stored time. Otherwise it increments a counter, sets a bit in a mask word, records the elapsed interval, and sets a flag when the counter reaches its stored limit. The referenced text is a qualifying heading.

name: update_countdown_budget
description: Calls routines depending on state flags, then reduces a countdown value by a term from a state word scaled down by 1024. The term has a minimum of 1, with extra deductions under some flags, and an accumulator is updated afterwards.

name: advance_session_phase
description: Checks several state words, then waits with timeouts, calls routines and advances the phase counter by one when its conditions hold. It leaves the phase unchanged when the earlier checks fail. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: send_phase_command_pair
description: Saves a timeout word and, when the phase counter is zero, sends command code 30 with a timeout of 800. It then waits until a busy word clears, sends command code 27 carrying the current phase, and restores the timeout word.

name: update_lead_standing_display
description: Compares two state values against a band of 180 to 224 and toggles a flag when a value enters or leaves that band. It then calls many routines to update the standings text. The referenced text includes lead and position headings. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: forward_call_keep_result
description: Calls one routine and returns the input register values unchanged.

name: apply_temporary_offset_pair
description: Saves two offset words, calls several routines, and adds sampled values minus 24 to the two offsets. It calls two more routines and then restores the saved offsets.

name: dispatch_on_positive_result
description: Calls one routine and checks a global flag and the sign of the returned high word. It then calls one of two follow-up routines, depending on whether the value is below two or not.

name: start_timed_counter_once
description: On the first call only, sends command code 12 when a state word is positive, increments a counter and sets a deadline 5000 units after the current timer value. It then calls one routine.

name: set_timed_deadline_from_table
description: Clears a timer field and two counters, sets one counter to 15, and sets a deadline from a table entry multiplied by five plus a routine result multiplied by four. It sets a flag when a table byte is nonzero.

name: reset_timed_counters_and_send
description: When a state word is positive, sends command code 13. It then calls one routine, sets a counter to minus 15, clears two deadlines to minus one, and clears a flag.

name: refresh_display_view
description: When a display flag is set, clamps a timer value and calls routines to update the view state. It then loads the graphics view through the library and waits on the blitter and display timing through library calls. The referenced text includes a pit stop caption.

name: forward_one_call_passthrough
description: Calls one routine and returns the stack value unchanged. The listing is unreached in the static flow, and the decompiled body has no other work.

name: accumulate_projection_sums
description: Clears three accumulator words, then loops over a table of entries and adds weighted coordinate differences into the accumulators, calling a routine for each entry.

name: compute_face_normal_components
description: Computes coordinate differences between vertex entries taken from tables, forms the cross product of two difference vectors and divides the components by a routine result. A zero divisor is replaced by one before the division.

name: compute_coordinate_extents
description: When a flag word is zero, sets default values, then computes differences between the first and last entries of three coordinate tables and iterates over the entries to accumulate their extents.

name: compute_scaled_progress_values
description: Computes a scale value from a state table entry, using 3000 when that value is zero and capping a factor at 104. It then loops over entries and computes adjusted values with a routine.

name: reset_audio_channel_two_state
description: Sets a flag word to all ones, writes zero to the third audio channel's volume register, loads three values from tables along with their negated copies, and copies several state fields.

name: call_then_mark_flag_set
description: Calls one routine and then sets a flag word to minus one.

name: restore_saved_state_fields
description: Clears two flags, copies saved values of several state fields back into their live fields, and copies the live state into global storage. It calls four routines along the way.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: shift_history_entries_down
description: Shifts a list of paired 32-bit entries down by one position and stores the first entry at the end, keeping a rolling history. The listing is unreached in the static flow.

name: format_time_record_line
description: Writes the entry number as a decimal digit, copies a ten-character record label into the text line, and converts a time value to minutes, seconds and tenths. It writes those parts as decimal digits and a separator into fixed text cells.

name: format_time_record_into_buffer
description: Like its neighbour, but writes the record label and the minutes, seconds and tenths into a text buffer addressed by a state pointer, with a space separator.

name: plot_masked_bit_row
description: Calls several routines, then tests a mask word bit by bit to plot up to seven pixels into the destination at offsets taken from tables.

name: mark_result_rows_by_count
description: Writes a marker value of 13 into up to four text rows, selected by a count in a state word, calling one routine for each row. It then sets a field to 3.

name: copy_field_and_advance_offset
description: Copies one state word into a neighbouring field and increases another state word by 6.

name: format_average_lap_entries
description: Calls routines to read a time field, then when a count field is nonzero loops over up to 12 entries, formatting each one with routines. It returns the last computed value. The referenced text includes average and lap headings.

name: format_six_digit_or_blank
description: When a value is non-negative and below 1199981, writes its digits into six text cells. Otherwise it fills those cells with spaces. It then calls one routine.

name: copy_ten_character_label
description: Copies a ten-character label from the source pointer into a fixed text buffer, then calls one routine.

name: format_two_digit_number_text
description: Writes a value reduced modulo 100 as two decimal text digits, blanking a zero tens digit. It then calls one routine and writes further digits into fixed text cells.

name: split_time_into_digit_cells
description: Converts a half-unit time count into minutes, seconds and hundredths, storing each part as decimal characters in fixed text cells.

name: format_elapsed_time_display
description: Sets four state words to fixed values, then formats the time elapsed since a stored start (halved) into digit cells. It calls one routine to complete the display.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: call_routine_with_two_buffers
description: When a flag is set or a state word is zero, calls one routine twice, switching the text pointer between two buffers, and then restores the pointer.

name: format_remaining_count_display
description: Sets four state words to fixed values, then computes a remaining count, either from a maximum minus a state word or from a state word clamped at zero. It writes its tens digit when nonzero and calls routines to finish the text.

name: format_entry_position_labels
description: Walks up to two entries of the record list, writing each record's label character and a two-digit position number into text cells. It then fills the remaining cells with spaces. The referenced text includes a lap heading.

name: update_record_ranking_threshold
description: Finds the smallest stored value across the record list, excluding one special record, then compares each entry with a threshold derived from a state word. Entries above the threshold are set to a sentinel value of 65000, and one routine is called.

name: find_record_by_label
description: Searches the record list for an entry whose key matches the given key and returns minus one if none is found. When one is found, it writes its one-based position digit and label characters into text cells and calls one routine.

name: cycle_record_display_entry
description: Advances a rotating index over the record list, finds the record at that index, and writes its one-based position digit and label into text cells. It returns minus one when no record exists. The referenced text includes a qualifying heading.

name: advance_record_cursor
description: When two state words are zero, moves a cursor to the next record index with wraparound at a limit. It copies the record's stored value into a state field and sets two follow-up fields to a sentinel and zero.

name: format_signed_delta_text
description: When a state word is zero, writes a plus or minus sign and a record label character, then formats a value divided by 20 into digit cells with blank padding and a decimal point.

name: compare_adjacent_record_keys
description: Walks adjacent pairs of the record list, builds a combined key from two fields of each record, and compares the keys. It calls routines for each pair. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: set_timing_baseline_and_deadline
description: Records the current timer value as a baseline. When a mode word is nonnegative it clears a value, calls a routine, and sets a deadline from speed-like and remaining-count values. Otherwise it updates a record field and a timer value from a routine.

name: sort_record_list_by_key
description: Repeatedly passes over the linked list of records, relinking a record after its successor when that successor has a smaller key. It returns its input register unchanged.

name: update_segment_position_fields
description: Walks track segment entries, computes coordinates and distances from table values and the segment index, and calls routines to store the results. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: update_trigger_flag_state
description: When two state words are zero and a table value at a state-indexed position is below 1, checks a state word and a table value, then sets a flag and calls one routine. Otherwise it clears the flag.

name: select_handler_by_mode
description: Calls one routine when a mode word is 3 or any value other than 1, and a different routine when the mode word is 1.

name: forward_to_one_subroutine
description: Calls one routine and returns, passing nothing and changing no state.

name: update_qualifying_state_step
description: Returns its input unchanged when any of three state flags is set. Otherwise it calls several routines and updates a qualifying-phase value. The referenced text is a qualifying heading. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: run_wait_message_update
description: Clears two state fields and returns early when a routine result is negative. It calls several routines and, depending on state, shows or clears wait and warning messages. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: update_timing_entry_values
description: Computes timing and position values from state fields and a routine result, then calls nine routines to store them. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: update_all_audio_volumes
description: When a state word is nonzero, calls many routines and writes the volume registers of all four audio channels. The referenced text includes a please-wait caption.

name: load_entry_table_fields
description: Calls one routine, then loads three table values for the current index into position fields along with their negated copies, and zeroes a set of counter fields.

name: clear_session_counters
description: Zeroes twelve state fields, covering counters, rates and offsets.

name: apply_half_offset_pair
description: Saves two offset words, adds a routine result minus half of the input to each, calls two routines, then restores the saved offsets.

name: rebuild_eight_row_table
description: Loops eight times, copying an eight-word table into a buffer and calling routines on each pass. It then reads two table entries for the current index into state fields.

name: load_position_entry_with_offset
description: Clears a field, loads three table values for the current index into position fields with a fixed offset added to one of them, computes a derived difference, and calls routines to store the results.

name: tick_frame_counter_and_update
description: Increments a 32-bit frame counter, calls three routines, and makes further calls depending on two state flags.

name: reset_and_run_update_set
description: Calls three routines, clears two state words, then calls five more routines.

name: select_entry_and_load_position
description: Calls routines, copies a state index into the current-index field, and loads a position value from a table for that index with a fixed secondary value. It sets flags depending on a routine result and clears one related field. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: start_sound_load_wait
description: Calls ten routines, sets several state values and a count, then waits up to 12000 timer units for a status flag to change. The referenced text is a disk path to sound data.

name: reset_session_state_flags
description: Calls many routines and resets a set of state fields and flags. It also waits for vertical blank through the graphics library. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: clear_bitmap_then_update
description: Calls three routines in sequence. One of them clears a bitmap through the graphics library BltClear entry.

name: check_stage_completion
description: Adds two state values and compares the sum with a threshold. When the stage counter reaches 4 it runs end-of-stage steps and resets flags, otherwise it loads the next entry's fields from a table and updates state. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: compute_scaled_ratio_and_copy
description: Computes a fixed-point ratio of two input values, using a divisor of 10 when their sum is zero. It then copies an eight-word table into state and calls routines.

name: next_index_wrapped
description: Returns the input value plus one, wrapping to zero when it reaches the limit stored in a state field.

name: forward_to_one_subroutine
description: Calls one routine and returns, passing nothing and changing no state.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: compute_segment_delta_and_index
description: Clears two state words, selects a segment index that steps back when it equals a limit, computes coordinate differences for that segment from three tables, calls routines to store them, and returns the index.

name: copy_table_row_negated_offset
description: Calls two routines, stores the negated value of a state field, copies an eight-word table into the working buffer, and clears a flag.

name: measure_elapsed_timer_interval
description: Computes the timer interval since the previous call, stores it with the current timer value, and when the interval is above 500 and below a stored best it records the new best and calls one routine. It returns zero when a state word is negative.

name: run_pair_with_saved_pointer
description: When a state word is nonzero or a flag is zero, saves a pointer, calls one routine, then sets the pointer and calls another routine before restoring the saved value.

name: configure_text_layout_and_draw
description: Sets four text layout fields to 15, 4, 18 and 12, then calls two routines.

name: draw_panel_with_table_value
description: When a state word is zero and a flag bit is clear, saves two pointers, calls one routine with fixed arguments and a table value, then restores the pointers with a further call.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: transform_and_store_points
description: Computes transformed coordinates for several points from table values and writes them into state arrays, calling three routines along the way. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: insert_into_sorted_slot_list
description: Finds a position for a new entry in a four-slot list stored in the state block, shifts entries as needed, and orders the list by a key field. It calls thirteen routines. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: shift_buffer_and_select_draw
description: Subtracts 32 from a state word, shifts two buffer entries by one slot, calls one routine, then calls one of two routines depending on the low four bits of the input register.

name: select_draw_by_low_nibble
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether the low four bits of the input register are zero.

name: compute_clamped_level_value
description: When a state word is nonnegative and a flag is clear, computes a value from that word scaled by 66 over 256 plus 75, clamps it to 127, stores it, and calls five routines with the clamped value.

name: send_effect_request_a
description: When two flags are clear and a state word is nonzero, saves a pointer, sends an effect request with fixed arguments through one routine, then restores the pointer and calls another routine.

name: send_effect_request_b
description: When two flags are clear and a state word is nonzero, saves a pointer, sends an effect request with a second fixed argument set through one routine, then restores the pointer and calls another routine.

name: send_effect_request_c
description: When two flags are clear and a state word is nonzero, saves a pointer, sends an effect request with a third fixed argument set through one routine, then restores the pointer and calls another routine.

name: send_effect_request_d
description: Sends an effect request with a fixed argument set through one routine when its guard conditions hold, then restores a saved pointer and calls another routine.

name: update_channel_three_volume
description: Computes a volume value from two input registers and a table lookup, writes it to the fourth audio channel's volume register through a global, and updates several state fields before calling one routine.

name: toggle_marker_pattern
description: When a state word is nonzero, toggles a 12-value marker pattern at two offsets in a table. Otherwise it toggles a single marker entry at a state-indexed offset.

name: repeat_until_zero_result
description: Calls a test routine repeatedly, calling a second routine after each nonzero result, and stops when the test returns zero.

name: set_default_display_limits
description: Sets two layout fields and four limit fields to fixed default values, then copies two of those values into paired fields.

name: initialize_display_session
description: Resets several timing and display fields to initial values, calls routines, and prepares text buffers from a state table. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: initialize_options_screen
description: Resets many state fields, calls about forty routines and loads a graphics view through the library. The referenced text includes an options artwork path and credit names. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: draw_numbered_tune_entry
description: Calls two routines, then either calls one routine or, when a flag is set, writes an incremented digit into a text cell and calls another. The referenced text is a tune-up artwork path.

name: configure_options_pointer_pair
description: Sets two pointer pairs to the global buffer, writes two constants, calls five routines, then resets the pointers and calls further routines depending on a state word. The referenced text includes an options artwork path.

name: reset_layout_and_load_view
description: Clears two state words, sets layout and timing constants, calls routines and loads the graphics view through the library.

name: run_option_selection_loop
description: Repeats a poll routine until it returns zero. It then loops reading a selection value, cycling one counter with wrap at 4 for value 1 and another with wrap at 2 for value 2, and calls routines each time. It returns when the value is zero or negative. The referenced text is a tune-up artwork path.

name: run_parity_dispatch_loop
description: Unreached in the static flow. It sets a counter to one or two depending on the low bit of its input, then loops calling routines and dispatching on state codes until a stop condition is met.

name: bind_buffer_pointer_and_render
description: Binds a pointer slot to the global buffer and then calls six routines in sequence.

name: compute_layout_scale_values
description: Scales a table entry by two clamped factors, caps each factor at 17, and stores the results as layout values together with derived timing and step values.

name: advance_selection_counters
description: When a state word is zero, either calls routines and sets a flag, or advances two counters and calls routines to update the selected entry. The decompiled body is truncated.
